open_points.subject: A04 trial-case add authority vs State 0 capture action
open_points.text: A04 rule 1: "A trial case is added only by an agent with the author right"; State 0 primary actions: "capture a failed execution into the trial corpus | owner, agent with author right"
open_points.question: Can the owner add a trial case through capture, or are all trial-case additions restricted to authoring agents only?
options: Owner and authoring agent may capture (State 0 action table governs capture)
Only authoring agents may add any trial case, including captured ones (A04 rule 1 governs all adds)
Owner may capture but not author ad-hoc trial cases
open_points.default_guess: Owner and authoring agent may capture; authored add remains authoring-agent only.

open_points.subject: Effectful flow activation request by agent when version is already active
open_points.text: State 0: "an agent asking to activate a version with effects is refused"; A06 rule 4: "Activating the version that is already active returns the active activation and records nothing, whoever asks."
open_points.question: If an agent requests activation of an already-active effectful version, must the kernel refuse or return the existing activation?
options: Always refuse agent activation requests for effectful versions, even if already active
Return existing active activation for already-active version regardless of actor
Return existing activation only for owner, refuse for agent
open_points.default_guess: Return existing activation unchanged for already-active version, regardless of actor.

open_points.subject: A11 resolution trace for not_applied outcome
open_points.text: A11 rule 1 says every attempt has "the NodeExecution of the owner's resolution (rule 3)", while A11 rule 3 says for `not_applied`: "the kernel writes no NodeExecution".
open_points.question: When the owner resolves `unknown` as `not_applied`, is a NodeExecution written for the resolution or not?
options: No NodeExecution is written; only EffectAttempt changes
A NodeExecution is written for resolution with same attempt number
Write NodeExecution only for `applied`, never for `not_applied`
open_points.default_guess: Write no NodeExecution for `not_applied`; keep only EffectAttempt as resolution record.

open_points.subject: Required service headers source and values
open_points.text: A08 rule 2 includes instance `required_headers`; A09 rule 1 sends "the headers the instance requires plus the credential"; A17 defines only one configured credential header reference per service.
open_points.question: How are required headers (other than the credential header) populated, validated, or refused?
options: Require required_headers to match exactly the configured credential header; otherwise refuse binding/invocation
Allow static required-header values from manifest (not modeled elsewhere)
Send only credential header and ignore other required_headers
open_points.default_guess: Refuse unless required_headers can be satisfied by the configured credential header definition.

open_points.subject: Binding-shape refusal at proposal time (A09 rule 2)
open_points.text: A09 rule 2: "A binding whose ports cannot fit this shape by their schemas is refused when proposed".
open_points.question: What exact static check determines that declared port schemas can/cannot fit path/query/json/multipart placement?
options: Conservative schema-subset check (only clearly compatible primitive/list shapes allowed)
No static schema-shape check; enforce only at send time
Best-effort static check with implementation-defined heuristics
open_points.default_guess: Use conservative static compatibility checks and refuse any schema not provably compatible.

open_points.subject: Spool run-size overflow cleanup scope
open_points.text: A15 rule 3: "a run whose spooled files together exceed `spool_run_bytes_max` ... concludes the producing node `resource_exhausted`, and nothing partial is kept."
open_points.question: On total spool overflow, what is removed: only partially written files of the current node attempt, or also previously completed spool files from earlier nodes in the same run?
options: Delete only partial/current-attempt files; keep previously completed spool files
Delete entire run spool immediately on overflow
Delete current node outputs (even complete ones) but keep earlier-node files
open_points.default_guess: Keep previously completed spool files; discard only current attempt’s partial/new outputs and fail the producing node.
